environment.sourceState: uncommitted v2 working tree during review

runs.cause: Cross-document ViewTransition opt-in mismatch produced browser diagnostics after otherwise successful interaction checks.

outcome.scope: Initial full suite plus targeted rerun, not two full-suite passes.

visualReview.method: Independent inspection of actual screenshot samples, decoded media contact sheets and temporal presentation logs.
observed: Four distinct front, side, elevated and reverse viewpoints with changed object overlap and negative space.
Flat readable HTML holds, copy cleared during principal sweeps.
Transparent edge-to-edge opening header and solid scrolled header.
Bounded horizontal project travel and release into bright studio.
Complete static mobile and tablet compositions; reduced-motion, media failure and no-JS reading flow.
limits: AI-assisted visual review is not client approval or user research.
Physical mobile devices, Firefox and Safari not tested in this review.
No claim of full WCAG conformance or production enquiry delivery.

investigation.issue: Some inline PNG tool previews appeared to omit fixed navigation.
investigation.resolution: Converting the exact existing PNG file to JPEG revealed the complete header without a new browser capture. Fresh JPEG captures also showed the header with and without compositor promotion. Evidence supports a preview artifact, not a demonstrated site defect.

evidenceLocation: Windows temp nulabs-web-qa-20261019/v2-integrated-01 and v2-integrated-02; machine-specific paths intentionally omitted from repository summary.
